name: Mounir Satouri - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT ‘Towards an EU strategy to protect and strengthen the international justice system and its institutions, mechanisms and partners’
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a single EU strategy to protect international courts and the people who work with them, above all the International Criminal Court. It condemns sanctions and pressure from outside the EU, especially from the United States and Russia, aimed at ICC judges, prosecutors and their partners. It asks the EU to activate its Blocking Statute, which shields EU people and companies from foreign sanctions, and to update it. It also wants better protection for witnesses, lawyers and civil society groups.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose a strategy, an action plan and a Blocking Statute update.
- **Who it affects:** ICC staff, EU citizens and companies hit by foreign sanctions, and civil society groups.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and EU governments decide whether to act on these requests.
